Layout is HINDI-page-then-ENGLISH-page pairs (idx 0 = bilingual cover, idx 1 = Hindi instructions, idx 2 = English instructions, then pairs 3/4, 5/6 ... 25/26); folio = idx + 1 and the last folio reads 'Page 27 of 27', matching the 27 rendered images. Every odd index was accounted for and all thirteen are pure Devanagari, so there is NO English overflow onto an odd page and no mid-paper parity inversion. The printed General Instructions CONFIRM the dispatched table for full70_phy_2023 exactly, including that D is LONG ANSWER and E is CASE-BASED (the reverse of Chemistry 2023): 35 questions, five sections, A = Q1-18 MCQ (1), B = Q19-25 VSA (2), C = Q26-30 SA (3), D = Q31-33 LA (5), E = Q34-35 case-based (4). 18+14+15+15+8 = 70. DECIMALS ARE RAISED on this paper - measured at 4x on Q4's options, where the dot sits at mid-x-height - so every decimal is written {\cdot}. Instruction (viii) prints internal-choice COUNTS - 2 in B, 2 in C, 3 in D, 2 in E - and all nine were found and confirmed against a printed 'OR' (Hindi 'अथवा'): Q19, Q21 | Q26, Q27 | Q31, Q32, Q33 | Q34(c), Q35(c). Q28 and Q30 each print (a) and (b) with NO OR in either language and only ONE marks figure, at the end of (b); the marking scheme confirms both are single 3-mark questions (Q28 = (a) 1+1/2+1/2 and (b) 1; Q30 = (a) 2 and (b) 1), so neither is an internal choice. The Section-A key was READ BY VISION from ms/p02 and is fully legible: 18 entries, 16 plain letters plus two voids (Q4 keyless, Q13 medium-scoped). A full scan of all 18 marking-scheme pages found TWO further award-regardless notes OUTSIDE Section A - Q20 (Section B) and Q33(a)(iii) (Section D) - both recorded in _cbseVoided. Section-E case-study sub-parts on this pattern are SUBJECTIVE: the scheme answers them with mark splits and worked working, so there are exactly 18 keyed answers on this paper, all in Section A, as the addendum's (pattern, subject) table predicts.
